current_date: February 2020 (stated as 'Local Validation List: last updated February 2020' on the council's Planning validation checklist page)
current_evidence: Braintree publishes its local list only as an online 'Planning validation requirements' directory (no PDF); the Local validation list page links to the category/294 document index Grokbot used, and the Planning validation checklist page says the local list was last updated February 2020.

issues.detail: Grokbot marked the link as 'not readable: blocked/404/login' and captured zero requirements, but the link loads fine and lists 50 document types, each with its own record and trigger. Every application type row in the workbook says 'Not covered', so none of Braintree's local list is in the workbook.
issues.evidence: category/294 'Types of planning document' lists 50 documents: Affordable housing statement ... Viability appraisals

issues.detail: Householder local requirements missing: Biodiversity checklist (site in an Impact Risk Zone, in an SSSI, within 100m of a nature reserve, local wildlife site or priority habitat, triggers RAMS, protected species, or works to buildings); Annexe accommodation justification statement (annexe in the curtilage); Car parking and access (hardstandings, garages, car ports); Listed building section drawings (upper-floor accommodation or signage on a listed building); Site levels (levels condition or a material change in levels); Tree assessment (works to protected trees); Amendment statement (revisions to an approved scheme); Members/employees declaration.
issues.evidence: directory-record/6425 Householder planning consent, 'Sometimes required' list

issues.detail: Residential new build and major local requirements missing: Biodiversity pro forma (always); Car parking and access (always); Amenity garden statement (all majors and all new dwellings); Refuse strategy (all new dwellings); HRA/RAMS contribution (net gain of 1 or more dwellings in the zone of influence); Affordable housing statement (residential majors); Place making strategy, Statement of community involvement, Open space/S106 and management plans, Proposed site drainage strategy, Infrastructure/utilities assessment and Major application information (all majors); Landscape impact assessment (majors in the countryside or on the settlement edge); Marketing appraisal (loss of agricultural occupancy, rural commercial premises or village pub, residential reuse of rural buildings); Viability appraisal (loss of rural commercial premises or a reduced S106 offer); Contamination risk assessment (sensitive end uses); Noise, Air quality, Lighting, Phasing plans, Structural survey, Transport assessment/travel plan.
issues.evidence: directory-record/6475 Residential new build, 'Always required' and 'Sometimes required' tables (page modified 2026-07-28)

issues.detail: Requirements for other application types were not captured either. The directory has separate pages for 22 application types, for example Listed building consent, Advertising consent, Prior approvals, Telecommunications (Telecommunications supporting information), Commercial/industrial, Change of use, Residential conversions, Permission in principle, Discharge of conditions and Technical details consent.

The List date is blank. The council's Planning validation checklist page gives the local list as last updated February 2020, which is more than 6 years old. Individual directory pages have been edited since (the residential new build page was modified 28 July 2026).

summary: Grokbot's link works and is the council's current online local list (a directory, last updated February 2020 according to the council). Grokbot wrongly recorded it as unreadable and captured no requirements, so dozens of local requirements across 22 application types are missing.
